articles.title: What is TraderTraitor, the hacking squad behind the $6.3 billion Binance heist?
articles.snippet: The hacking group has been behind some of the crypto industry's most recent high-profile thefts.

articles.title: The pile of lawsuits against Kalshi just grew by one
articles.snippet: Arkansas has accused the prediction market of running illegal gambling, joining Utah and several other U.S. states that have filed criminal or civil charges.

articles.title: Thailand to block Bitget in December over unlicensed crypto trading
articles.snippet: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, with access to its website and app set to be blocked from Dec. 5.
